input.question: Are musicians brains "wired" differently than non-musicians?
input.ground_truth: A well-trained musician can hear notes and different types of instruments in pieces. They study music and can decipher music regularly. I would say anyone can learn music and be able to create a song if you learn the foundations of music.

response.prediction: Okay! Imagine your brain is like a big city with lots and lots of roads (those are the “wires”). When you practice music a lot, some of those roads get used more, so they get bigger and stronger. This is what people mean when they say “musicians’ brains are wired differently.” It’s like how if you ride your bike every day, your legs get stronger. If you play music a lot, some parts of your brain get extra good at things like listening, remembering, and moving your hands. But everyone’s brain is a little different, even if they aren’t musicians!
